fact_sources.fact: About 5.5 lakh tickets sold for 17-20 Dec shows, excluding blocked seats (as of 20 Nov)
About ₹35 crore gross (Koimoi/Cinema Express ₹34.96 cr; Sacnilk ₹35.37 cr without blocked seats), ₹29.6 crore net

About 2.4 lakh opening-day tickets over 2,000+ shows (CE 2.42 lakh/2,020 shows; Sacnilk 2.45 lakh/2,100 shows); average ticket about ₹690 (Sacnilk ₹692, CE ₹694); English leads (Sacnilk day 1 English ₹14.31 cr of ₹17.09 cr; CE)
India release Thu 17 Dec, a day before the US (18 Dec); four-day opening 17-20 Dec
First shows from 12:01 AM on 17 Dec (BH: Cinepolis Viviana Mall, Thane 12:01 am; Koimoi: shows from 12:01 AM)
